title.th: คำสั่งจัดหางาน (การยกเว้น) 2014

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Employment Agencies (Exemption) Order 2014 and shall come into operation on 1st July 2014.

2. Subject to the conditions specified in the Schedule, section 6 of the Act shall not apply in respect of the carrying on of an employment agency, or the performance of any work or activity referred to in section 6(2) of the Act, by any person appointed by the Skills and Workforce Development Agency (established by section 3 of the Skills and Workforce Development Agency Act 2026) to carry on that employment agency or perform that work or activity.
[S 458/2016 wef 03/10/2016]
[S 459/2016 wef 04/10/2016]
[S 418/2026 wef 01/07/2026]

THE SCHEDULE
Paragraph 2
Conditions
1.The person only —
(a)carries on that employment agency; or
(b)performs that work or activity,
for or in connection with the employment of citizens or permanent residents of Singapore.
2.The person does not charge any fee in respect of the carrying on of that employment agency or the performance of that work or activity.
3.The person’s primary work or activity is not the carrying on of any employment agency or the performance of any work or activity referred to in section 6(2) of the Act.
